name: rename-lattice-to-proof-or-stop-docs
title: Rename the lattice CLI brand to proof-or-stop: bin, active docs, and brand-pinned gates
description: The command tool and product are being rebranded from lattice to proof-or-stop. Replace every lattice brand mention in ACTIVE documentation with the appropriate proof-or-stop form, and rename the user-facing CLI invocation so the docs stay truthful. Scope boundaries that must hold: (1) frozen historical records under .lattice/story/ are an audit trail and must NOT be rewritten; (2) signature salt literals such as lattice-review-integrity-v1 are hashed into stored _hash fields on live artifacts, so renaming them would invalidate every existing signature and gate-block all active stories; (3) the .lattice/ on-disk state directory and lattice-* agent role IDs may only move if code, host shims and docs move atomically. Docs must never claim a command or path that does not actually work.
